Through the chilled fog drifting along the flagstones, the gentle warmth of starlight spirits who had watched over these archives for centuries still lingered. Embedded like luminous constellations into the obsidian walls were the archaic cross-shaped stigmata of the holy order, casting radiant amber beams into the shadows.

scenes.narrationEn: Cilia drew near, clasping his weathered hand, and decoded the four cardinal runes inscribed along the margin.

scenes.narrationEn: "The northern snow, the oceanic gale, the imperial sacred flame, and the guardian shield of the earth... The intersection where these four primordial forces converge is the Throne of Ruin where Lucian awaits.
scenes.narrationKo: 실리아가 자신의 녹옥 지팡이를 바람의 자리에 맞추어 꽂았다. “바람 속삭임 섬의 넋과 이그니스의 불꽃, 그리고 카단의 방패가 하나로 이어졌어요. 이제 루시안의 나인섀도우 결계를 단숨에 해체할 수 있어요.”

scenes.narrationEn: Master left us the ultimate key to victory."

scenes.narrationEn: Kadan retrieved Ignis's White Glass Ember from his tunic and nestled it upon the sacred flame node of the parchment.

scenes.narrationEn: Clenching his fist, Kadan looked upon the light. "Ignis breathes alongside us even now.

scenes.narrationEn: The three flames and the sacred shield are finally united."
scenes.narrationKo: “선대 영웅들의 모든 맹세가 우리 손끝에 모였어요.”

scenes.narrationEn: Cilia nodded, aligning her jade staff with the wind node.
scenes.narrationKo: 성채 하층부에서 울려 퍼지는 함성은 연합군의 사기를 드높이기에 충분했다. 펜릴 왕이 이끄는 북방의 전사들이 루시안의 잔여 마수 군단을 차례로 유린하며 최상층으로 향하는 외곽 방어선을 완벽하게 차단해주고 있었다.

scenes.narrationEn: "All the solemn oaths of the ancient heroes have gathered at our fingertips." Kadan unsheathed the Silver Dagger, resting its tip at the map's nexus. "Master Aleksandar, Uncle Balian, and Ignis stand with us.

scenes.narrationEn: We have no time to linger in grief." Suddenly, thunderous hoofbeats and the resonant roars of great wolves pierced the nocturnal air from the abyss beneath the terrace. King Fenrir's Silver Wolf Vanguard had enveloped the lower bastion of the Black Citadel, launching a fierce assault against the demonic legions.

scenes.narrationEn: The battle cries echoing from the lower terraces reignited the spirits of the allied hosts.

scenes.narrationEn: Because the northern beasts held the bloodstained sulfur swamps, Kadan and Cilia were freed from guarding their vanguard, able to focus their entire will upon the tyrant on the throne.

scenes.narrationEn: Kadan raised his Dragon Breaker shield toward the warriors battling below. "King Fenrir's loyalty has lifted the burden from our shoulders. Now it is our turn to cleave the tyrant on the throne."

scenes.narrationEn: Kadan offered a warm, unwavering smile.

dialogues.textEn: Kadan drove his shield into the portal's center, shattering the massive stone gates in a roar of splintering granite.

scenes.narrationEn: Beyond lay the blood-drenched Throne of Ruin, and the monstrous silhouette of High Chancellor Lucian waiting in the dark.
scenes.narrationKo: 실리아가 속삭였다. “우리의 신념이 대륙의 어둠을 밝힐 거예요.” 카단이 방패를 세우며 화답했다. “가자. 평화로운 새벽을 되찾으러!”

dialogues.textKo: “우리의 신념이 대륙의 어둠을 밝힐 거예요.”
dialogues.textEn: “Beyond lay the blood-drenched Throne of Ruin, and the monstrous silhouette of High Chancellor Lucian waiting in the dark.”
